investigation_notes.Alert Name: Microsoft Defender: Potentially Unwanted Application Prevented
investigation_notes.Description: Antivirus blocked a detection labeled PUA:MacOS/MacKeeper on a .lock file inside a Gradle cache while the Gradle daemon was running under idea64.exe. The file path and process chain indicate development/build activity (Gradle/IDE), and the MD5 corresponds to an empty file which is consistent with a lock artifact rather than an installer; no external destination IPs or network indicators are present in the alert. Because the event was prevented, originates from developer tooling on a workstation, and shows no signs of persistence or external communication, this alert is assessed as Low Priority.
